facts.statement: The sale's offer period started at 04:01 Brasília time on 8 October 2012 and ended at 03:59 on 8 December 2012 (dates as written in DD/MM format).
facts.quote: Oferta válida apartir de 04:01 (horário de Brasília) do dia 8/10/2012 até ás 3:59 da manhã do dia 8/12/2012

article_summaries.title: Vem aí- Liquidação do Fim de Semana!
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language Free Realms news post (page title in the French-language site frame: 'Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ?') announcing a weekend sale: up to 30% off Station Cash items in the in-game Marketplace, with a stated validity window. The post gives no game mechanics beyond the sale, and its publication date is only given relative to the capture ('2 months, 3 weeks ago'), so the exact date is unknown.
